Aikido Security identified 42 pages on Hugging Face Spaces that impersonated 28 brands, including Microsoft, Google, PayPal, Chase, and Coinbase. Researchers linked 29 of the pages to DeepSite. items.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Hex.pm Vulnerability to Execute Commands on Six Servers
items.description: A critical Hex.pm vulnerability was exploited on November 23, 2026, allowing attackers to execute operating system commands on six web servers. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-129514, carries a maximum severity score of 10.0 and required no account. Hex blocked the attack and deployed a fix within 20 minutes.
